summary: Two-part round shaft-to-wheel adapter. A stepped hub has a central shaft bore, three axial screw holes on its smaller step, and two radial holes in its larger step. A thin round washer with a central hole and three screw holes clamps the wheel against the hub. The overall envelope is estimated, not read from a drawing.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat face of the smaller hub step, which seats against the wheel and carries the three clamp-screw holes.
Outer face of the washer, which clamps the wheel against the hub.
Flat back face of the larger hub step, on the motor side.

notes: No dimensions are printed in the images, and the supplied dimensions_mm fields are null, so the overall size and hole positions are rough visual estimates. Only the 4 mm shaft bore comes from the listing. The 3 mm screw-hole size is assumed from the stated M3 screws, and the 4 mm radial hole size from the stated M4 set screws. The washer's central hole is visible, but its diameter is unverified. The hub's three screw holes are shown blind (through: false) because their depth is not visible. The washer holes are listed as through at z=6, but the 3.2 mm size and the position are guesses. Verify all values against a datasheet before using them for CAD.
